description: Sessionize raw click events for the content platform. Events of a user are ordered by event_ts (ties by event_id). A new session starts at the user's first event and whenever the gap from the user's previous event is STRICTLY greater than 30 minutes. Number the sessions per user starting at 1. Sessions may cross midnight and must not be split at day boundaries. Exclude events of users flagged as bots. Output columns: user_id (INT64), session_seq (INT64), session_start (TIMESTAMP), session_end (TIMESTAMP, timestamp of the last event), event_count (INT64). Sort by user_id, session_seq.
edge_cases: Gap of exactly 30 minutes (10:20 -> 10:50) stays in the same session
Gap of 30 minutes and 1 second starts a new session
Session crossing midnight is one session
common_failure_modes: FM2: Using >= 30 minutes, or TIMESTAMP_DIFF(..., MINUTE) which truncates 30m01s to 30, puts the boundary on the wrong side
FM3: Partitioning by user and date splits midnight-crossing sessions
FM4: Nesting LAG inside SUM() OVER in one expression is not allowed; the new-session flag must be computed in a prior CTE
